description: Extended Data-native Python vendor connectors, capability dispatch, SecretSync integration, and pytest support.
rules: Vendor Fabric extends Extended Data. Keep generic capability routing in VendorData instead of adding provider-specific facade methods.
Providers must keep optional SDK imports lazy and present missing extras with actionable installation guidance.
Keep the SecretSync binding facade thin. Do not create a competing sync pipeline in vendor-fabric.
Agent orchestration, runners, and MCP helpers belong in agentic-fabric, not this package.
Sourcey Markdown in docs is the authoritative public documentation. Do not reintroduce Sphinx or a parallel documentation site.
pytest-vendor-fabric is for provider and connector testing. Live vendor E2E tests remain explicitly opt-in with --e2e.
